descriptionHtml:
The Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the IEEE Student Branch, University of Peradeniya, was held on September 3, 2025 in physical from 5:15 PM to 6:30 PM, with over 50 members in attendance at DEEE Seminar Room of the University of Peradeniya. The meeting commenced with a welcome address by the outgoing chair, Mr. Thiliru Samaradiwakara, followed by the presentation of the Annual Report summarizing the chapter’s activities and achievements. The Treasurer’s Report was then delivered by Mr. Thimira Peiris. The election of new office bearers for the 2025-26 term took place, with Mr. Vihanga Madugalla appointed as the new chairperson, proposed by Mr. Dilan Pramuditha and seconded by Mr. Dushan Kaveesha. Additionally, Dr. Ruwan Ranaweera was appointed as the new adviser, nominated by Mr. Thimira Peiris and seconded by Mr. Dilan Pramuditha. Dr. Ranaweera acknowledged the contributions of the former committee, congratulated the newly appointed members, and encouraged them to explore new technical areas and projects. The AGM concluded with the appointment of the remaining office bearers, ensuring a smooth transition of leadership for the upcoming year.
